updates.title: La Mancha gets festival weekend under way with tapas before the tunes
updates.body:
La Mancha is getting into the Feel Good Festival spirit ahead of the weekend, inviting festival-goers to make the popular Rochdale town-centre restaurant their first stop before heading to the music.

The Spanish restaurant is promoting tapas, cocktails and sangria for visitors looking to eat and drink before the festival action, with its town-centre location making it a convenient pre-event stop.

The festival weekend brings a major line-up into Rochdale, and town-centre bars and restaurants are preparing for increased footfall as visitors arrive for the live music and wider entertainment programme.

La Mancha is encouraging customers planning to visit over the festival weekend to book a table in advance.

updates.title: Welcome to our live festival coverage
updates.body:
Rochdale's biggest weekend of the year is here, and we'll be posting updates on this page throughout — set times as they're confirmed, what's happening around the town centre, and anything you need to know before heading in.

The main event is tomorrow, Saturday 8 August: the festival opens at 11.30am, with BRIT Award winner Gabrielle headlining the main stage in Town Hall Square, joined on the bill by Ash, Starsailor and more, alongside the Food and Drink Village and live music in venues across the town centre. Tonight's ticketed warm-up show gets the weekend under way.

For the full rundown of the bill, entry rules, travel and accessibility, read our complete festival guide linked at the top of this page.
